punchline: Aimee Mullins gave a TED talk on prosthetics, yet Gallo says her real passion was human potential.
thirty_sec: Carmine Gallo studied more than five hundred TED talks and made passion his first secret. His example is Aimee Mullins, an athlete with double leg amputations who spoke about prosthetics. Gallo says she cares less about prosthetics than about unleashing human potential. His advice: find what sits under your topic before you prepare, because that is what the audience catches.
